[LGRA.10.6] **A payload kwarg may take a dynamic expression.** On `call`, a
user-declared kwarg ([LGRA.10.3.3]) — a kwarg the resolved service declares —
admits any expression the action's context allows, not only a literal. A kwarg
declared with a schema or with `Schema` takes a pattern binding instead
([LADP.8.6.1]).

A `call`'s correlation is not a kwarg. It is the trailing `as <expr>` clause
([LRST.1.1]), and it is an expression too.
